title: test-quality measure: add cold/warm lint-format times and coverage overhead, then validate the report against compratuentrada (357.11 s case)
notes: compratuentrada). Extend the existing `test-quality` audit to report cold
and warm lint/format times, full test wall time and phase shares, slowest
files, unnecessary DOM environments, coverage overhead, worker count and
host load. Where the installed Vitest supports it, run `vitest doctor` on
representative subsets as an opt-in diagnostic, record passing and failing
candidates, and confirm any recommendation against the full suite before
changing defaults. Compare equivalent runs before recommending a change;
keep CI's cold checks and all tests and coverage thresholds. Evidence: in
compratuentrada, cached ESLint fell from 188.41 s to 7.99 s and Prettier
from 54.09 s to 14.69 s, while 991 Vitest files still took 357.11 s. A
33-file `vitest doctor` sample recommended disabling isolation (9.01 s to
4.76 s), but a three-worker variant failed; this is not proof for the full
suite. Smallest next step: define a portable, read-only report for one
consumer and validate its findings against this case before rolling it

2026-11-23: measure now reports host-load, phase-shares and worker-processes (a sampled floor, not a ceiling), on top of suite-run, slowest-files and memory-use. Still missing: cold and warm lint/format times, unnecessary DOM environments in the report, coverage overhead, the opt-in vitest doctor subset run, and validation of the report against the compratuentrada case. Smallest next step: run codeality-test measure in compratuentrada and compare with the 357.11 s figure.

2026-11-24 audit: verified in packages/test-quality: observations host-load, phase-shares, worker-processes, slowest-files, suite-run, memory-use exist (commit cf2c000a); README documents manual `vitest doctor` on a subset (not automated in measure); DOM candidates live in inventoryReport only (src/commands/inventoryReport.ts), via --node-candidates. Still missing: cold/warm lint/format timing, coverage overhead, DOM-env finding inside measure report, opt-in doctor run, validation vs compratuentrada.
